page_title: NAN 2-2 MON | Nantes v Monaco 10/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Anthony Lopes leaps to intercept the corner kick from Lamine Camara (Monaco).
90+3' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Monaco earn a corner.
90+3' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Monaco will take a corner kick.
90+1' Lamine Camara (Monaco) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is comfortably saved by Anthony Lopes.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Marc Bollengier blows the whistle, Matthis Abline (Nantes) is penalised for a foul. Monaco have a free kick from a promising distance.
89' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) tries to find Breel Embolo with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
89' Half-chance! Caio Henrique (Monaco) plays a pass into the box, but Anthony Lopes reacts well to snuff out the attack.
87' The referee is firm and issues Johann Lepenant (Nantes) a deserved yellow card.

85' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Philipp Kohn pulls off an easy save.
84' Breel Embolo almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Denis Zakaria (Monaco) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' What a chance that is! Moses Simon (Nantes) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!

81' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
80' Vanderson (Monaco) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

79' So close! Caio Henrique (Monaco) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
78' Substitution. Sorba Thomas is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
78' Poor challenge! Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) is penalised for tripping and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. Monaco win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
76' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) sends a long ball forward to Caio Henrique, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
74' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar.
73' Lucas Michal (Monaco) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Vanderson.
72' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) and Matthis Abline try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
70' Antoine Kombouare is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Nathan Zeze (Nantes) suffers an injury and Jean-Philippe Gbamin comes on.
69' It doesn’t look good for Nathan Zeze (Nantes); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
68' Vanderson (Monaco) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
68' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
66' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' Matthis Abline (Nantes) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
62' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Lucas Michal (Monaco) is replacing Saimon Bouabre.
61' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caio Henrique (Monaco) replacing Kassoum Ouattara.
60' Lamine Camara (Monaco) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

59' 2 - 2 The ball was swung into the box by Lamine Camara from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Mohammed Salisu (Monaco), who planted a header into the back of the net to make the score 2:2.
58' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
56' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
56' Lamine Camara (Monaco) prepares to take a corner kick.
56' Surely that's handball by one of the Nantes players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
55' Lamine Camara (Monaco) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

55' Anthony Lopes makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the roof of the net. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
53' The game is interrupted. Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
53' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Marc Bollengier to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Monaco players can finally celebrate.
53' The Monaco players halt their celebrations as referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
52' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Wilfried Singo slips the ball through to Breel Embolo (Monaco), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:1.
49' A cross into the box from Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is cleared.

47' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Kelvin Amian (Nantes) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top right corner. The assist goes to Sorba Thomas and the score changes to 2:0.
46' A cross from Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.

43' Moses Simon (Nantes) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. A big rebound falls at the feet of Sorba Thomas (Nantes). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates.
42' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. Nantes will take a free kick.
41' Lamine Camara (Monaco) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
41' Lamine Camara (Monaco) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.

41' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
39' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
37' Great ball in from Kassoum Ouattara. Breel Embolo (Monaco) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
36' The resulting corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
34' Moses Simon (Nantes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' The game is interrupted now, Moses Simon (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Vanderson (Monaco) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Nantes will take a throw-in.
28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
26' The ball is cleared after Moses Simon (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

24' A neat pass finds Lamine Camara (Monaco) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Anthony Lopes denies him with a good save. Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
23' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vanderson (Monaco).
23' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes the corner which is cleared.
22' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Nantes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
19' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Referee Marc Bollengier sees the trip by Moses Simon (Nantes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
16' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
12' 1 - 0 Goal Matthis Abline (Nantes)! Matthis Abline (Nantes) was put through by Sorba Thomas and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

11' Moses Simon (Nantes) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Philipp Kohn guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
11' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul. Nantes earn a free kick.
7' Lamine Camara (Monaco) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
7' Saimon Bouabre (Monaco) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Nantes.
5' Breel Embolo (Monaco) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
5' Good defending. Saimon Bouabre (Monaco) tries to find Kassoum Ouattara inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
4' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) sends a long ball in, but Philipp Kohn comfortably gathers the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monaco will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier is the one to supervise the game today.
